title: Indian Workers Record Jobs to Train AI Systems
excerpt: Workers in India are receiving payments to record videos of themselves performing everyday tasks, which are then used to train artificial intelligence models.
body_html:
Workers in India are being paid to record videos of themselves while performing their daily jobs. This recorded footage serves as training data for artificial intelligence models.

As the demand for data to build and refine artificial intelligence continues to grow, capturing real-world human actions through video has become an active area of labor. The process involves individuals documenting their routine workplace activities, which are subsequently utilized to help AI systems better understand and interpret physical tasks.
